## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2017-09-08: Unexecuted draft TRA filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the S-1
- 2017-10-05: IPO closed; executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.1 to the closing 8-K

#### Merger announcement and TRA termination

- 2022-05-11: Amendment No. 1 executed concurrent with the DigitalBridge / IFM Investors merger agreement; substitutes a fixed $0.37/Unit cash payment for all TRA payment formulas and automatically terminates the TRA
- 2022-12-07: Merger closed, triggering the contingent payment date; aggregate $75.1M cash settlement due "as promptly as practicable" after close

## Explanation

Switch, Inc. executed this TRA on October 5, 2017 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of Switch, Ltd. Common Units for Class A common stock. The TRA liability grew steadily from initial recognition of $52.5M at year-end 2018 to $395.6M at year-end 2021. On May 11, 2022, concurrent with the announcement of the DigitalBridge / IFM Investors take-private merger, Switch and the supermajority of Continuing Members executed Amendment No. 1, which substituted a fixed $0.37 per Common Unit cash payment for all Tax Benefit and Early Termination Payments and automatically terminated the TRA; the company recognized a $372.8M gain on termination and remeasured the residual current liability to $75.1M. The cash payment was contingent on the earlier of merger close or December 31, 2022; the merger closed December 7, 2022 and Switch deregistered on December 16, 2022. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
